change_summary: Stacked on PR 472. Remove EV-derived star ratings from the NFL run-it runner and every exported artifact, run frozen v5 in a serialized scratch directory so its legacy picks.csv cannot leak or overwrite files, guarantee restoration of v5.N_FIT, working directory and scratch cleanup on failure, and extend the existing NFL hosted workflow to execute the new regression modules. No pricing, blend, hold, selection or v5 behavior changes.
assumptions: Passing CI shows the synthetic regression suite executes; it does not validate predictive accuracy, calibration, odds, or profitability.
Stars remain unavailable until a validated calibration exists; every row is PAPER/0u and NON_COUNTED.
Serialization is per-process only; separate processes are isolated by their own working directories.

evaluation.test_command: python -m unittest -v engine.test_run_nfl engine.test_run_nfl_stars engine.test_run_nfl_artifacts engine.test_run_nfl_isolation
